verdict.rationale: Rippling's own IAM page claims its federated identity handles LDAP and RADIUS alongside SAML/OIDC/SCIM, so the product names both legacy protocols. That is a single marketing sentence: it does not say Rippling hosts cloud LDAP/RADIUS endpoints, and it does not show VPN or Wi-Fi authentication working. missing for 10: explicit cloud-hosted LDAP/RADIUS endpoint documentation, VPN and Wi-Fi (802.1X) setup guidance, configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, legacy protocols still work — cloud LDAP and RADIUS endpoints serve the VPNs, Wi-Fi, and older systems that will never speak SAML

citations.quote: Federated identity lets you handle any protocol with ease—from LDAP, Active Directory (AD), OIDC, and RADIUS, to custom SCIM and SAML apps.
